items.source: Empty implementation of BeanFactoryPostProcessor.postProcessBeanFactory(ConfigurableListableBeanFactory) since custom BeanDefinitionRegistryPostProcessor implementations will typically only provide a postProcessBeanDefinitionRegistry(BeanDefinitionRegistry) method.
items.translation: `BeanFactoryPostProcessor.postProcessBeanFactory(ConfigurableListableBeanFactory)` 的空实现，因为自定义的 `BeanDefinitionRegistryPostProcessor` 实现通常仅提供 `postProcessBeanDefinitionRegistry(BeanDefinitionRegistry)` 方法。

items.source: Extension to the standard BeanFactoryPostProcessor SPI, allowing for the registration of further bean definitions before regular BeanFactoryPostProcessor detection kicks in. In particular, BeanDefinitionRegistryPostProcessor may register further bean definitions which in turn define BeanFactoryPostProcessor instances.
items.translation: 对标准BeanFactoryPostProcessor SPI 的扩展，允许在常规 BeanFactoryPostProcessor 检测启动之前注册更多的 bean 定义。特别是，BeanDefinitionRegistryPostProcessor 可以注册更多的 bean 定义，而这些定义反过来又定义了 BeanFactoryPostProcessor 实例。

items.source:
Modify the application context's internal bean definition registry after its
standard initialization. All regular bean definitions will have been loaded,
but no beans will have been instantiated yet. This allows for adding further
bean definitions before the next post-processing phase kicks in.
items.translation: 在标准初始化之后修改应用程序上下文的内部 Bean 定义注册表。此时所有常规的 Bean 定义都已被加载，但尚未实例化任何 Bean。这允许在下一次后处理阶段启动之前添加更多的 Bean 定义。
